purpose: Improve lesson clarity, reduce guessing, strengthen weak-skill practice, and validate the learning experience with beginners.

objectives.title: Improve lesson quality
objectives.description: Rewrite lessons so each concept includes a plain-language explanation, correct CNC context, a worked example, and a clear takeaway.

objectives.title: Remove guessing-based questions
objectives.description: Replace ambiguous prompts with explicit instructions, sufficient context, and answerable CNC scenarios.

objectives.title: Strengthen weak-spot practice
objectives.description: Track missed concepts and generate focused review exercises until the learner demonstrates mastery.

objectives.title: Validate with beginner users
objectives.description: Test lesson clarity, navigation, feedback, and retention with users who have little or no G-code experience.

tasks.title: Audit all existing lessons
tasks.description: Identify inaccurate explanations, missing context, unclear wording, duplicate content, and questions that require guessing.
acceptance_criteria: Every lesson has been reviewed.
Each issue is categorized by accuracy, clarity, difficulty, or interaction design.
Critical machining inaccuracies are corrected before new content is added.

tasks.title: Apply a standard lesson structure
tasks.description: Use a consistent sequence: objective, explanation, syntax, worked example, common mistake, guided practice, and recap.
acceptance_criteria: Every lesson states what the learner will be able to do.
Every code lesson includes valid syntax and at least one realistic example.
Machine-specific differences are labeled instead of presented as universal behavior.

tasks.title: Replace guessing questions
tasks.description: Rewrite prompts so the learner has enough information to reason to one defensible answer.
acceptance_criteria: No question depends on hidden assumptions.
Distractors are plausible but clearly incorrect for a known reason.
Feedback explains why the selected answer is correct or incorrect.

tasks.title: Add guided practice before assessment
tasks.description: Introduce new concepts with hints and scaffolding before presenting independent quiz questions.
acceptance_criteria: New concepts are not assessed before being explained.
Hints are available without immediately revealing the answer.
The final exercise can be completed without hints.

tasks.title: Tag lessons and questions by skill
tasks.description: Assign stable skill identifiers such as rapid positioning, linear feed, arcs, offsets, spindle control, canned cycles, and safety basics.
acceptance_criteria: Every graded question maps to at least one skill ID.
Missed answers update the learner's weak-skill record.
Skill IDs remain stable across app updates.

tasks.title: Generate targeted review sessions
tasks.description: Build short practice sets from recently missed or low-mastery skills.
acceptance_criteria: Review sessions prioritize weak skills over mastered skills.
Repeated questions vary examples rather than repeating identical wording.
A skill leaves weak status only after repeated correct application.

tasks.title: Run beginner test sessions
tasks.description: Observe users completing onboarding, one lesson, one quiz, and one review session without coaching.
acceptance_criteria: At least five beginner users complete a test session.
Confusing wording and navigation failures are recorded.
Users can explain the main lesson concept after completion.

tasks.title: Prioritize findings and revise
tasks.description: Rank findings by severity and fix blockers before cosmetic issues.
acceptance_criteria: All blocking issues have owners and statuses.
Critical clarity issues are fixed and retested.
A short test report records outcomes and remaining risks.

evaluation_criteria.name: Lesson clarity
evaluation_criteria.measurement: Percentage of beginner testers who complete a lesson without external explanation.

evaluation_criteria.name: Question quality
evaluation_criteria.measurement: Percentage of incorrect answers where users report misunderstanding the concept rather than misunderstanding the wording.

evaluation_criteria.name: Immediate learning
evaluation_criteria.measurement: Average score on the first independent practice set after instruction.

evaluation_criteria.name: Retention
evaluation_criteria.measurement: Average score when the same skill is reassessed after at least seven days.

evaluation_criteria.name: User confidence
evaluation_criteria.measurement: Beginner self-rating before and after completing the tested lesson path.
evaluation_criteria.target: Positive improvement for at least 80% of testers

content_rules: Do not present controller-specific behavior as universal.
Do not encourage running unverified code on a real machine.
Use simulated or clearly labeled examples for training.
Explain abbreviations and parameters when first introduced.
Prefer realistic machining context over trivia or memorization-only questions.
Every incorrect answer must receive useful corrective feedback.
definition_of_done: All current lessons pass the lesson-quality checklist.
Ambiguous guessing questions have been removed or rewritten.
Weak-skill practice is driven by actual learner errors.
Beginner testing is completed and critical findings are resolved.
Evaluation metrics are recorded in a repeatable test report.
